name: donor-receipts
description: Review US donation acknowledgments and Givebutter receipts using gift records, approved benefit values, account status and campaign/account message settings. Use when you ask to fix a donation tax letter, check a benefit disclosure, or explain a Givebutter receipt amount or message. Works from pasted receipts, gift exports and settings text. Returns corrected acknowledgment wording, itemized amount checks and specific message repairs. Not for fundraising appeals, tax-return preparation, 1099-K filing, account access or sending receipts.
